title: Merchant Activation and Upsell Automation
summary: Spot merchants stuck between approval and first live transaction, send help specific to their blocker over WhatsApp and email, and time upsell prompts to real usage signals.

seo.title: Merchant Activation and Upsell Automation | VipraTech
seo.description: Detect stalled merchant integrations from API and onboarding signals, send blocker-specific help and brief account managers on activation and upsell.

problem.intro: Signing a merchant is not the same as processing their payments. Many stall between KYC approval and the first live transaction: API keys never used, a plugin half-installed, webhooks failing in sandbox. Later, active merchants who would benefit from payment links, QR, subscriptions or faster settlement never hear about them at the right moment.

pain_points.title: Silent drop-off after approval
pain_points.detail: Account managers cannot watch every new merchant's integration progress, so stalled accounts go unnoticed for weeks.

pain_points.title: Generic nudges
pain_points.detail: Blanket reminders to complete integration ignore the actual blocker, such as a webhook signature error or a pending KYC document.

pain_points.title: Upsell at the wrong moment
pain_points.detail: Offers go out by calendar rather than when behaviour shows a need, such as rising international card declines or manual payout volumes.

pain_points.title: Messaging compliance
pain_points.detail: WhatsApp opt-ins, DLT-registered SMS templates and DPDP consent must hold across every automated message.

solution.overview: We build an activation and upsell engine that reads merchant lifecycle signals from your onboarding system, dashboard analytics, API logs and transaction data. It places each merchant at a stage, such as KYC pending, keys generated, sandbox errors or live with no volume, and identifies the most likely blocker. An LLM drafts a message for that blocker from your approved content library: the right plugin guide, the specific webhook error explained, or a link to book integration help. Messages go out over WhatsApp, email or SMS within opt-in and template rules, and high-value merchants go to an account manager with a briefing instead. Upsell prompts follow behaviour, not a calendar.
capabilities: Lifecycle staging from onboarding, dashboard, API log and transaction signals
Blocker detection for KYC gaps, sandbox errors, plugin issues and zero-volume live accounts
Message drafting from an approved content library in English, Hindi and Hinglish
WhatsApp, email and SMS delivery within opt-in, DND and template rules
Account manager briefings for high-value or stuck merchants, pushed to your CRM
Behaviour-based prompts for payment links, QR, subscriptions, payouts or faster settlement

workflow.title: Collect lifecycle signals
workflow.detail: Onboarding status, dashboard logins, API calls, error logs and transaction volumes are pulled daily for each merchant.

workflow.title: Stage and diagnose
workflow.detail: Each merchant is given a lifecycle stage and a likely blocker or opportunity.

workflow.title: Choose the route
workflow.detail: Rules decide between an automated message and an account manager task, based on merchant value, consent and past responses.

workflow.title: Draft from approved content
workflow.detail: The LLM writes a specific message using only approved snippets, links and offers.

workflow.title: Send or brief
workflow.detail: Messages go out within consent and template rules, or the account manager receives a briefing in the CRM.

workflow.title: Track and tune
workflow.detail: Replies, integration progress and first transactions are tracked, and stage rules are tuned with your growth team.

inputs: Onboarding and KYC status per merchant
Dashboard login and feature usage events
API key, sandbox and webhook error logs
Transaction volume, refund and decline trends
outputs: Lifecycle stage and likely blocker per merchant
Personalised WhatsApp, email or SMS messages
Account manager briefings and CRM tasks
human_in_the_loop: Your growth team approves the content library, offers and stage rules, and account managers personally handle every high-value merchant. Any credit offer from a lending partner is sent only with content approved by that partner and your compliance team.
integrations: Product analytics such as Mixpanel, CleverTap or Amplitude
WhatsApp Business API, email and DLT-registered SMS providers
Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho or LeadSquared CRM
guardrails: Messages built only from approved snippets, links and offers, with no invented pricing or features
Consent, opt-out and DND checked before every send
Frequency caps per merchant across all channels
Credit offers held until compliance-approved content and lender disclosure are in place
Opt-out requests honoured across every channel straight away
compliance_notes: SMS and voice outreach follow TRAI commercial communication rules, including DLT-registered headers and templates.
Merchant contact data processed for a stated purpose with opt-out, in line with the DPDP Act 2023.
Lending-partner offers carry disclosures consistent with RBI's digital lending guidelines and stay under compliance control.

pilot.scope: Merchants approved in the last quarter who have not gone live, split into a test group that receives automated help and a control group handled as today.
deliverables: Approved content library for pilot messages
Account manager briefing integration with the CRM
Pilot report comparing test and control groups

what_we_measure.how: First live transaction within the pilot window, compared between the two groups.
Account manager review of whether the stated blocker matched reality for a sample of merchants.
Responses and opt-outs per channel and message type.
Time spent per stalled merchant with and without briefings, from CRM activity logs.

faqs.a: Frequency caps, consent checks and opt-outs apply across all channels, and messages are triggered by a specific blocker or behaviour rather than a calendar. Your team sets the limits.

faqs.q: Can it explain integration errors to developers?
faqs.a: Yes. It reads sandbox and webhook error patterns, such as signature mismatches or wrong callback URLs, and sends the developer the relevant guide section. It has no access to the merchant's own code or servers.
English, Hindi and Hinglish by default, with other Indian languages added for merchant segments that need them. Every message comes from your approved library.

faqs.q: Does it work with our CRM?
faqs.a: We integrate with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, LeadSquared or a custom CRM through APIs, creating tasks and briefings where account managers already work.
